title: Architecture team config
description: Schema for <home>/architecture.yaml and <home>/architecture.local.yaml: the decision-record keys /architecture:record-decision reads through the four layers of docs/adr/0075-resolve-plugin-settings-through-one-four-layer-cascade-and-a-bound-convention-home.md, the layout object /architecture:improve-layout and the improve object /architecture:improve read through the same layers, and the verification level /architecture:improve reads from the team file only. The map-* keys stay in the topic doc <home>/architecture/README.md (plugins/architecture/reference/config.md).

adr_template.description: Repo-relative path to the Markdown template /architecture:record-decision recommends when the repository has no ADR convention. A repository's own convention always wins. Default: the bundled skills/record-decision/templates/adr.md.

adr_extra_triggers.description: Extra conditions that join the ADR admission test's 'at least one' list (for example 'touches personal data'). A real alternative must still have been weighed.

adr_retirement.description: How /architecture:record-decision retires a record a new decision reverses, after the person's yes. delete: remove the file; its number is never reused. supersede: set its status to superseded by the new record. archive: move it to the ADR folder's archive folder.

layout.description: Settings for /architecture:improve-layout, the skill that checks whether files that change together live together. The commit and coupling filters default to code-maat's command-line defaults; the cluster size and pattern cutoffs are this plugin's judgment. Measures: plugins/architecture/skills/improve-layout/reference/co-change.md. A skill argument changes one key for one run.

history_commits.description: How many of the newest non-merge commits the lens reads.

min_revs.description: A file needs at least this many surviving commits to be paired.

min_shared_revs.description: A pair needs at least this many commits that change both files.

min_coupling.description: Lowest coupling degree, in percent, a pair may have.

max_coupling.description: Highest coupling degree, in percent, a pair may have.

max_changeset_size.description: A commit that changes more files than this is left out.

exclude_authors.description: A commit whose author name contains any of these strings is left out.

folder_depth.description: 0: a file's folder is its parent folder. N: a file's folder is its first N path segments, grouping deeper folders into one.

min_cluster_size.description: A cluster of files joined by passing pairs needs at least this many files to become a candidate.

encapsulated_min_focus.description: A cluster in one folder with at least this focus is well-encapsulated; below it, well-confined.

crosscutting_min_spread.description: A cluster touching at least this many folders, with focus at most crosscutting_max_focus, is crosscutting.

crosscutting_max_focus.description: Highest focus a crosscutting cluster may have.

improve.description: Settings for /architecture:improve. A value the invocation prompt names wins for that run. Keys: plugins/architecture/reference/config.md.

unattended_min_badge.description: The weakest badge an unattended deepening run writes to its candidate file. Speculative writes every band.

history_commits.description: How many of the newest commits a scan with no stated direction reads to find the paths that change most.

exclude_authors.description: A commit whose author name contains any of these strings is left out of that history read.

verification.description: How much independent checking this plugin's skills run: off, light (the default: skip the verifier dispatch), standard (run it) or strict (also run the optional passes). Read from the team file's committed copy on the default branch only, so a branch cannot lower it and architecture.local.yaml cannot set it. Levels: docs/contracts/verification-level/README.md.

verification_skills.description: Per-skill verification level, keyed by skill name (for example improve); an entry beats this file's verification value.
